ordered_diagnoses: Drug-induced blepharitis and ectropion associated with TNF-α inhibitors

s1.syndrome_frame: Blepharitis and ectropion in a patient with a history of Crohn disease and treatment with TNF-α inhibitors
salient_findings: Bilateral scaly, thickened, and erythematous upper and lower eyelids
Crusty plaques on the eyelid margins
key_facts: The patient is a 15-year-old boy
The patient has biopsy-proven Crohn disease
The patient was initially treated with infliximab
The patient was later switched to adalimumab due to disease relapse
The patient has bilateral scaly, thickened, and erythematous upper and lower eyelids
The patient has ectropion of both lower eyelids
The patient has crusty plaques on the eyelid margins
The patient has diffuse conjunctival hyperemia
The patient's visual acuity is 20/20 OU
The rest of the ophthalmic examination is unremarkable
